meta.parties: Commissioner of Income Tax v. Baddrawathie Fernando Charitable Trust

rules.statement: The expression 'charitable purposes' in section 7(1)(c), read with the definition of charitable purpose in section 2 prior to its amendment on 1st April 1959, excluded from its ambit purposes for the advancement of religion or for the maintenance of religious rites and practices.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not doubt, therefore, that these omissions were deliberate. I think that the definition of 'charitable purpose' in section 2 was intended to exclude from its ambit the advancement of religion or the maintenance of religious rites and practices."
